game.name: AstroForce
game.desc: AstroForce is a vertical shoot-'em-up for the Sega Master System developed by Enrique Ruiz (Eruiz00). Inspired by classic arcade shmups, it features multiple stages of intense spaceship combat with power-ups, enemy formations, and end-of-level bosses. A technical showcase for the Master System's capabilities and one of the most accomplished SMS homebrew titles ever released.
